rows.title: The germinal products confirmation page gives germinal transport guidance and names a missing ITAHC
rows.detail: Once a germinal products notification is submitted, its confirmation page tells the trader what still applies to the consignment. Germinal products do not stay at the place of destination for a certificate's time or 48 hours, so the germinal copy of the page gives only the two transport sentences that apply to every consignment. The germinal set carries the same certificate as live animals, so its page lists the ITAHC as still to upload on the same condition: whenever no uploaded document is of type ITAHC, whatever else was uploaded. The live animals confirmation page keeps the guidance it shows today.
acceptanceCriteria: On a submitted germinal products notification's confirmation page, the 'Transporting the consignment' section shows two paragraphs, 'Tell the transporter that this consignment must go directly to the place of destination on entry to Great Britain.' then 'The animals or consignment may need to be inspected.', and the next heading after them is 'How to view or amend this notification' (prototype:dr2-1-source prototype-dr2-1-source-p11-214; prototype:dr2-1-specs prototype-dr2-1-specs-p6-102; ruling:sam-2026-10-09-pm ruling-sam-2026-10-09-pm-p2-056)

A germinal products notification submitted with no uploaded document of type ITAHC shows, on its confirmation page, the heading 'Before the consignment is imported', 'You still need to:' and a bullet reading 'upload the ITAHC and any other required documents' (ruling:sam-2026-11-27 ruling-sam-2026-11-27-p1-001, ruling-sam-2026-11-27-p1-008; ruling:sam-2026-10-26 ruling-sam-2026-10-26-p1-021; repo:frontend repo-frontend-p7-063, repo-frontend-p7-064)

A germinal products notification submitted with a veterinary health certificate uploaded and no document of type ITAHC still shows the bullet 'upload the ITAHC and any other required documents' on its confirmation page (ruling:sam-2026-11-27 ruling-sam-2026-11-27-p1-008; ruling:sam-2026-10-26 ruling-sam-2026-10-26-p1-021)

A germinal products notification submitted with a document of type ITAHC uploaded and an identifier saved for every selected species shows 'Transporting the consignment' as the first heading after the reference panel on its confirmation page (ruling:sam-2026-11-27 ruling-sam-2026-11-27-p1-008; repo:frontend repo-frontend-p7-063, repo-frontend-p7-064)

On a submitted live animals notification's confirmation page, the 'Transporting the consignment' section shows 'Tell the transporter that this consignment must go directly to the place of destination on entry to Great Britain.', 'The animals or consignment may need to be inspected.', 'If so, the animals must stay at the place of destination for either:' and the bullets 'the time stated on the health certificate' and '48 hours if no time is specified' (prototype:dr2-1-source prototype-dr2-1-source-p11-214; repo:frontend repo-frontend-p7-071)
notes: Pass 1 gives two slices on one page, the germinal confirmation page: its shorter transport section (req-2755) and its ITAHC outstanding item (req-2756). Pass 2 combines them: the same submitted germinal notification set-up, the same page render and the same ladder.

c-364 (precedence): the 27 November ruling keeps the default, so the germinal copy names a missing ITAHC on the live-animals condition, and plants' confirmation gains no outstanding list. Nothing is overruled; this row touches no plants code.

The germinal confirmation page is a copy in the germinal products set, built with the set's review by inc-105, which already owns the page's return-to-list link. The combiner may merge this row into inc-105 (9 criteria, so 14 together); it is drafted apart because inc-105 is an existing row and these requirements are new to this re-distil.

The fifth criterion is a no-change guard on the live animals page, proving the stay sentence was left out of the germinal copy only. It asks for no edit to the live-animals confirmation folder, which the overview-and-review branch owns.
The fourth criterion assumes the germinal set's identifier rule (a species counts as identified once it has one identifier), which inc-183 builds.
